review_text: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription and it took support four days to refund the duplicate. Really frustrating.
Setup was surprisingly easy. The guided tour got my whole team running in under an hour. Great first experience!
The dashboard takes 30+ seconds to load every morning. We have a leadership meeting at 9am and this keeps making us late.
Support agent was friendly and solved my issue in one chat. Would happily contact them again.
Invoices are confusing. I can't tell which line items are usage fees versus the base plan. It's okay otherwise.
Importing our existing data failed three times with a vague error message. We're two weeks into the trial and still not live.
App crashes whenever I try to export a report larger than 500 rows. Have lost work multiple times.
Waited 6 days for a reply to my ticket. When it came, it was a canned response that did not address my question.
Please confirm whether annual plans can be switched to monthly mid-term. No urgency, just planning for next quarter.
The tutorial videos are helpful but a bit long. Would love a quick-start checklist instead.
Search is noticeably faster since the last update. Nice improvement, thank you to the team.
This is the third time I've had to explain my issue to a new agent. Nobody seems to read the ticket history. We are evaluating alternatives.
Price increase announced with only a week of notice. Feels disrespectful to long-time customers.
Onboarding call with the customer success manager was excellent. She tailored everything to our workflow.
Sync between mobile and web is unreliable. Changes made on my phone sometimes don't appear on desktop until the next day.
Help center articles are outdated. Screenshots don't match the current interface so I had to guess.
Billing portal is clean and I could download all my receipts in seconds. Exactly what I needed.
New users on my team keep getting stuck at the permissions step. Nothing explains what each role can do.
Works fine for me. Nothing special, nothing broken. Average performance overall.
Chat support resolved my login lockout in five minutes. Impressive turnaround!
